turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning! I'm going to be your anesthesiologist for your upcoming cholecystectomy. Can you please start by telling me a bit about your medical history and why you're having this surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Morning, doc. Yeah, I've been having a lot of tummy pains, especially after eating. The scans showed gallstones, so the doctor said it's best to take out the gallbladder. Hope that fixes the problem, lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for sharing that. Now, let's go over your medications. I see you're on Atorvastatin, Metformin, Lisinopril, and Aspirin. Can you confirm if you're still taking all of these, and if not, what changes have been made?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Ah, the Aspirin... I stopped that about six months ago because it was giving me bad stomach issues, like acid or something. My heart doctor then put me on Clopidogrel 75 mg daily instead for protection.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for clarifying that. It's important we have the most current medication list. Just to confirm, are you still taking Atorvastatin 20 mg daily, Metformin 500 mg twice daily, and Lisinopril 10 mg daily without any issues?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, doc, all those are still the same. No problems with them, touch wood.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Now, about allergies, we have you down as allergic to Penicillin with a rash. Has there been any other allergic reactions to foods, medications, or latex that we should know about?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, just the Penicillin. That's the only one.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Have you had any previous surgeries or anesthesia? If so, how did you tolerate them?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Once, for my appendix, about ten years back. I was under general, and I woke up with a sore throat, but that was about it. No other issues, I think.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: A sore throat can be a common side effect. We'll note that. Now, regarding your diabetes, how have you been managing it? Are your blood sugars under good control with Metformin?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yeah, I check regularly. Sometimes it fluctuates, but generally, it's okay. My HbA1c was 7.2% at the last check, I think.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. Finally, for this surgery, we're planning for general anesthesia with a Laryngeal Mask Airway (LMA). Have you had any issues with breathing or airway problems in the past that we should be aware of?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, doc, I don't think so. Breathing's always been fine for me.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: And just to confirm, when's the last time you had anything to eat or drink? We need to ensure you're NPO (nil per os) status is appropriate for surgery.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I had dinner around 8 pm last night and just water this morning, but nothing after midnight, as instructed.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect, thank you. I think that covers everything. Do you have any questions for me about the anesthesia or the procedure?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, doc, I think you've covered it all. Just ready to get this done.
